scheme_name: Scheme For Waiver Of Loans To Handloom And Powerloom Sector
other_conditions: Loans disbursed to Individual Weavers and Weaver Groups for weaving purposes that were outstanding on 31.03.2014 are eligible.
Individual Weavers who have directly availed loans for weaving purposes are eligible.
Weaver Groups that have availed loans for weaving purposes on a pro‑rata basis as per the amount drawn by each member are eligible, subject to the overall ceiling.
Credit extended to holders of Weaver Credit Cards is eligible.
Weavers having Power Loom Units below 5 HP capacity and availing the existing 50 % Power subsidy scheme are eligible.
The loan amount eligible for redemption is limited to ₹1,00,000 per individual Weaver and ₹5,00,000 per Weaver Group, with the per‑individual limit within a group also capped at ₹1,00,000.
benefits_summary: The scheme waives outstanding loans for eligible individual weavers and weaver groups—up to ₹1 lakh per individual and ₹5 lakh per group—enabling them to obtain fresh financing.
